name: British National Grid forward and inverse (OSGB36 / British National Grid — EPSG::27700)

source.page: EPSG registry + EPSG Geomatics Guidance Note 7-2 §1.3.5 (Transverse Mercator)
source.notes: Transverse Mercator, central meridian −2°, latitude of origin 49°, false easting 400000 m, false northing −100000 m, scale factor 0.9996012717, Airy 1830 ellipsoid (a=6377563.396 m, 1/f=299.3249646). Input geographic coordinates are OSGB36 (EPSG:4277) — Helmert-shifted from WGS84 at ~100 m level; the 4326→27700 path includes a datum shift, so the fixture uses the 4277 geographic directly. Frozen from pyproj EPSG:4277 → EPSG:27700 validated against sidecar Snyder (USGS PP-1395 §8).

cases.name: London (51.5°N, 0.1°W → BNG)
cases.notes: Central London. Cross-checked with pyproj EPSG:4277 (OSGB36) → EPSG:27700 (E=531866.1304, N=179660.9048). The WGS84→27700 path gives E=531979.29 N=179606.91 (113 m datum shift) — not used. Sidecar Snyder matches OSGB36 path within 0.0001 m.

roundtrip_test.description: Forward then inverse must reproduce the input geographic coordinates to within 1e-7 deg (~1 cm).
